name: vsi-bench-qa-v3-hm3d-full
description: vsi-bench-qa-v3-hm3d-full is a visual question-answering dataset built on HM3D 3D indoor environments that pairs visual observations with QA items. It measures models' ability to answer questions requiring spatial, object, and relational reasoning from scene viewpoints. Tasks reflect embodied/scene-grounded QA challenges common in embodied vision-and-language research.
reputation: A niche dataset used by researchers working on embodied VQA and HM3D-based scene understanding, with moderate adoption within that community.
